entities.summary: The Jāmeh Mosque of Qerveh, also known as the Qerveh Spacious Mosque, is a Shi'ite Friday mosque (jāmeh) located in Qerveh, in Abhar County, in the province of Zanjan, Iran. The mosque was completed in the 5th century AH, during the Seljuk era.
